description: R0 extension part: Mapbox's own shader precompiler is started when the app has added its layers (moves ~90 ms of blocking shader-link waits off the main thread)

patches.note: T4(map) is the function that adds the app's own sources and layers (roads, rivers, breastworks, farms and their labels) after the map's 'load' event; it runs for the desktop map in every train and, from group C on, for the phone map. Mapbox GL 3.24.1 compiles a program the first time a layer draws with it and then blocks the main thread on getProgramParameter(LINK_STATUS) until the GPU process has linked it (Program._finalize): symbol/SDF 80-100 ms, line 15-20 ms each in a software-GL lab (SwiftShader, which is also what Lighthouse/PageSpeed run on), a few ms on a GPU. Mapbox has a precompiler for exactly this (style._programPrecompiler, program creation in idle slices, the GPU process links in parallel because KHR_parallel_shader_compile is on) but it only runs on the map's 'idle' event, which comes after those frames, and it knows no symbol layers. gtPrecompile(map) (called at the end of T4): style._programPrecompiler.reset() so that the next style update re-reads the new layers and rebuilds the queue, then after that frame it adds the one program the precompiler cannot derive (text SDF symbol, same defines and UBO size Mapbox's draw code builds, so the cache key matches) and runs the queue in ONE short task with an unbounded deadline, so every program is requested before the first frame that draws it and links while the main thread is free. Without KHR_parallel_shader_compile (program creation is synchronous there) it does nothing: the unbounded batch would only move the same blocking work into one long task. Everything is in try/catch and uses only fields of the pinned bundle (a different Mapbox build makes it a no-op). Measured (Lighthouse 13.5, real tiles, mobile, interleaved, n = 12-13 per cell): R1c 85 -> 97, TBT 588 -> 195 ms; R0 82 -> 90; the screenshot after idle is byte-identical (sha1) and the rendered-feature counts per layer are equal; Mapbox's own compile statistics: stall 138-160 ms -> 17 ms, programs precompiled 0 -> 3. See runbook 14.18/14.19/14.21 and tests/t0/perf-fixes.spec.mjs PF-07..PF-10.
